title: Pressure injury prevention

sources.use: International Guideline 4th ed.: abridged Quick Reference Guide only

objectives: Check skin under and around devices.
Document assessments and reasons for deviation.

items.text: Applies to all ICU patients; extra care with vasopressors, shock, diabetes and peripheral arterial disease.
Use equipment and low-friction fabrics that reduce friction and shear when moving the patient.
Offload heels; manage moisture; request nutrition screening and dietitian review.
Risk scale choice and who may apply specialised surfaces and dressings follow local policy.
Check under and around devices and securements; support or reposition devices; consider preventive dressings under devices; remove devices as soon as medically feasible (a prescriber decision).
Turning technique and positions during haemodynamic instability follow the unit's approved procedure.
Reposition on a schedule set by mobility, skin and tissue tolerance, clinical condition, comfort and the support surface, not a fixed rule.
Report new skin changes and device-related damage promptly.
Document assessments, interventions and refusals or reasons for deviation.

checklist.text: Inspect skin, including under and around devices and over bony prominences.
Reposition according to the individualised plan.
Offload heels and reduce friction and shear when moving the patient.
Check devices and securements and support or reposition them.
Record findings, actions and reasons for deviation.
